characters.name: Baron Von Bedtime
characters.epithet: Duke of Naps, Archduke of Dread

leaderSkill.name: Mandatory Lights Out
leaderSkill.desc: Dark allies HP x1.5 and ATK x2.5.

activeSkill.name: Aggressive Lullaby
activeSkill.desc: Delay all enemies by 2. They suddenly feel like a little lie-down.

passive.name: Well Rested
passive.desc: Dark attacks against Light enemies deal +25% damage. Eight full hours.

awakened.epithet: Emperor of the Eternal Snooze Button
awakened.abilityDesc: Aggressive Lullaby also converts Light orbs to Dark orbs. His cape becomes a duvet of state.

characters.flavor: Conquers kingdoms strictly between 7 and 8pm. After that, the empire goes to sleep. No exceptions.

characters.name: Edgelord Kevin II

leaderSkill.name: Twice the Blades
leaderSkill.desc: Dark allies ATK x3 when HP is below 50%. It's not a phase.

activeSkill.name: Crimson Whatever
activeSkill.desc: Deal massive Dark damage to one enemy. He named this move at age 14.

passive.name: Brooding
passive.desc: +20% ATK while any ally is defeated. He feels it deeply.

awakened.epithet: He Has Three Swords Now (The Third Is Metaphorical)
awakened.abilityDesc: Crimson Whatever hits all enemies with a full-screen cut-in of him looking away dramatically.

characters.flavor: Kevin the First was his grandfather, a beloved accountant. Kevin II chose... a different path.

characters.name: Goth Librarian Morticia

leaderSkill.name: Silence in the Stacks
leaderSkill.desc: Dark allies ATK x2. Enemies feel judged.

activeSkill.name: Overdue Notice
activeSkill.desc: Deal Dark damage and bind the target. The fine compounds hourly.

passive.name: Dewey Decimal Doom
passive.desc: +15% skill charge from Dark matches. Everything catalogued.

characters.flavor: Her library has a restricted section, a forbidden section, and a section that files YOU.

characters.name: Mildly Cursed Mimic Milton

leaderSkill.name: Surprise Inside
leaderSkill.desc: Object allies HP x1.8 and ATK x1.5.

activeSkill.name: Chomp Therapy
activeSkill.desc: Deal Dark damage to one enemy. It's a breakthrough.

passive.name: Wooden Exterior
passive.desc: Takes 15% less physical damage. Fully varnished.

characters.flavor: In recovery for eating adventurers. Attends a support group with two doors and a suspicious barrel.

characters.name: Shadow Puppet Pete

activeSkill.name: Convincing Rabbit
activeSkill.desc: Deal Dark damage. The enemy believes in the rabbit.

passive.name: Two-Dimensional
passive.desc: 10% chance to dodge attacks by turning sideways.

characters.flavor: Nobody has found the person making the shadows. There may not be one. Do not check behind the sheet.

characters.name: Discount Witch Wanda

leaderSkill.name: Clearance Hex
leaderSkill.desc: Dark allies ATK x1.6. Terms apply.

activeSkill.name: Bulk Curse
activeSkill.desc: Deal Dark damage to all enemies. While supplies last.

passive.name: Store Brand Magic
passive.desc: Skills cost 10% less charge. Quality may vary.

characters.flavor: Her curses are 40% off and 60% effective. The math works out. Do not ask for refunds.

characters.name: Ominous Sock

activeSkill.name: Lurk in the Dryer
activeSkill.desc: Delay one enemy. It cannot explain why it feels dread.

passive.name: Unpaired
passive.desc: +10% ATK when no other Object ally is in the party. Alone. Always alone.

characters.flavor: Where is the other sock? WHERE IS THE OTHER SOCK? It knows. It will never tell.

characters.name: Spooky Pebble

activeSkill.name: Menace
activeSkill.desc: Deal a tiny amount of Dark damage. The enemy is unnerved.

passive.name: Igneous
passive.desc: It is technically a rock. Takes 10% less damage.

characters.flavor: Warm Rock's estranged cousin. They do not speak. The family gatherings are unbearable.
